headword: {印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}

definitions.gloss: printing company; print shop; printing firm
definitions.explanation: A company that provides printing services — from large commercial printers handling books, magazines, and packaging to smaller shops for business cards, flyers, and promotional materials.

examples.japanese: {印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}に{名刺|めいし}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered business cards from a printing company.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{地元|じもと}の{印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: My father works at a local printing company.

examples.japanese: デジタル{化|か}が{進|すす}んで、{印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}は{新|あたら}しいビジネスモデルを{模索|もさく}している。
examples.english: As digitalization progresses, printing companies are searching for new business models.

notes:
Composed of {印刷|いんさつ} (printing) + {会社|がいしゃ} (company). Japan has a long and significant printing industry, with major companies like {大日本印刷|だいにっぽんいんさつ} (DNP) and {凸版印刷|とっぱんいんさつ} (Toppan) being among the world's largest.

The {会社|がいしゃ} suffix combines with many industry terms to form company names: {建設|けんせつ}{会社|がいしゃ} (construction company), {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ} (insurance company), {運送|うんそう}{会社|がいしゃ} (shipping company).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}に{依頼|いらい}する: to commission a printing company
- {大手|おおて}{印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}: major printing company
- {印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}の{見積|みつも}もり: printing company estimate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {印刷所|いんさつじょ}: print shop — often smaller-scale
- {印刷屋|いんさつや}: printer, print shop — more colloquial
- {出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}: publisher — publishes content, may or may not print
